decisions.headline: 《VRChat》开始为从Built-in RP迁移至URP做准备
decisions.summary: VRChat公司披露，计划把《VRChat》的渲染管线从Built-in RP迁移至Universal Render Pipeline；即将开展的Android构建向iOS构建自动转换功能，也将作为URP迁移实验。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON将迁移计划和自动转换实验归因于VRChat公司的公开说明，并区分计划与已完成事项。
decisions.reason: 平台技术路线具有创作者生态影响，计划范围可由已打开报道有界表述。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON标注发布时间为2026年11月6日10:03:30 UTC。

decisions.titleEn: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
decisions.headline: 《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版新增跳跃操作引发玩家落崖趣闻
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON观察到，《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版11月5日在Nintendo Switch 2发售后，部分熟悉原作自动跳跃机制的老玩家因不习惯新增跳跃按钮而频繁失足，并在社交平台分享片段。
decisions.verification: 报道明确给出发售日、Nintendo Switch 2平台与新增跳跃按钮，并将玩家反应表述为社交平台观察。
decisions.reason: 属于有具体机制背景的社区观察，不把个别片段扩大为全体玩家结论。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON标注发布时间为2026年11月6日07:52:43 UTC。

decisions.headline: 《Metaphor: ReFantazio》数字版将于11月12日下调价格
decisions.summary: Atlus宣布，《Metaphor: ReFantazio》数字标准版将于11月12日从9878日元调至3990日元，35周年数字纪念版则从15500日元调至5990日元；新价格将随Nintendo Switch 2版发售在各数字商店生效。
decisions.verification: AUTOMATON将价格、执行日期和Nintendo Switch 2版节点归因于Atlus公告，并列出两个数字版本的调整前后价格。
decisions.reason: 大幅永久价格调整具有行业与消费者信息价值，数字版本和时间范围明确。
decisions.timeNote: AUTOMATON标注发布时间为2026年11月6日04:10:18 UTC。

entries.headline: VRChat begins preparing to move from Built-in RP to URP
entries.summary: VRChat Inc. says it plans to migrate VRChat from the Built-in Render Pipeline to the Universal Render Pipeline. A planned automatic Android-to-iOS build conversion feature will also serve as an experiment for the URP transition.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON attributes both the migration plan and conversion experiment to VRChat’s public update and keeps planned work distinct from completed changes.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 10:03:30 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Ocarina of Time remake’s new jump input sparks player mishaps
entries.summary: AUTOMATON observed players sharing clips after The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake launched for Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5. Some veterans accustomed to the original game’s automatic jumping struggled with the newly added jump button and fell from ledges.
entries.verification: The report provides the launch date, Nintendo Switch 2 platform, and new jump input, while presenting the reactions as a social-media observation rather than a universal response.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 07:52:43 UTC on November 6, 2026.

entries.headline: Metaphor: ReFantazio digital editions receive major price cuts on November 12
entries.summary: Atlus announced that Metaphor: ReFantazio’s standard digital edition will fall from ¥9,878 to ¥3,990 on November 12, while the 35th Digital Anniversary Edition will drop from ¥15,500 to ¥5,990. The new prices take effect across digital stores alongside the Nintendo Switch 2 release.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON attributes the prices, effective date, and Nintendo Switch 2 timing to Atlus and lists the before-and-after prices for both digital editions.
entries.timeNote: AUTOMATON lists publication at 04:10:18 UTC on November 6, 2026.
